label: SYNTHETIC sample data — fictional DTC beauty brand reviews for demo. Not real customers.

reviews.original_text: सर्विस बहुत अच्छी थी लेकिन डिलीवरी तीन दिन लेट हो गई। प्रोडक्ट क्वालिटी ठीक है।
reviews.english_translation: Service was very good but delivery was three days late. Product quality is fine.

reviews.original_text: पैकेजिंग खराब थी, बॉटल लीक हो रही थी। रिफंड जल्दी मिल गया इसलिए 3 स्टार।
reviews.english_translation: Packaging was bad, the bottle was leaking. Refund came quickly so 3 stars.

reviews.original_text: டெலிவரி சூப்பர். கிரீம் மிகவும் நல்லா இருக்கு. மீண்டும் ஆர்டர் பண்ணுவேன்.
reviews.english_translation: Delivery was super. The cream is very good. I will order again.

reviews.original_text: কাস্টমার কেয়ার ফোন ধরেনি। দুইবার মেইল করেও উত্তর পাইনি।
reviews.english_translation: Customer care did not pick up the phone. Emailed twice and still no reply.

reviews.original_text: किंमत थोडी जास्त वाटते पण रिझल्ट दिसायला लागला. आपल्या फ्रेंडला सुचवेन.
reviews.english_translation: Price feels a bit high but results started showing. I will recommend to a friend.

reviews.original_text: ఆర్డర్ రావడానికి ఒక వారం పట్టింది. యాప్ ట్రాకింగ్ కూడా పని చేయలేదు.
reviews.english_translation: Order took a week to arrive. App tracking also did not work.

reviews.original_text: WhatsApp पे सपोर्ट ने 5 मिनट में जवाब दिया। बहुत खुश हूँ, 5 स्टार।
reviews.english_translation: Support replied on WhatsApp in 5 minutes. Very happy, 5 stars.

reviews.original_text: પ્રોડક્ટ ઓકે છે પણ સાઈઝ ચાર્ટ ગેરમાર્ગે દોરે છે. એક સાઈઝ નાની આવી.
reviews.english_translation: Product is okay but the size chart is misleading. One size came small.
